postgresql_network_policy: private-only; never enable public access to bypass gateway or licensing requirements

live_service_outcome.route: Power BI virtual network data gateway connected to the deployment VNet

requirements.tenant_access: Power BI/Fabric tenant must permit virtual network data gateways and the PostgreSQL connector.
requirements.workspace_license: Workspace and report users require an eligible Power BI license.
requirements.capacity: Workspace must be assigned to eligible Premium or Fabric capacity supporting VNet data gateways.
requirements.gateway_region: Gateway, workspace capacity, VNet, and PostgreSQL region pairing must be supported; candidate region is unapproved until Gate B.
requirements.subnet: Use the dedicated power-bi-gateway subnet delegated to Microsoft.PowerPlatform/vnetaccesslinks.
network_permissions: Power Platform VNet access-link permissions on the dedicated subnet
No network security rule may block PostgreSQL 5432 or required Azure control-plane endpoints
Private DNS zone private.postgres.database.azure.com must resolve from the gateway subnet
requirements.connector: Power BI PostgreSQL connector with TLS required and the private PostgreSQL FQDN; no IP-address or public-endpoint fallback.
requirements.credential_storage: Store a least-privilege read-only reporting database credential in the Power BI gateway connection; do not embed it in PBIX, JSON, or source control.
requirements.refresh: Import mode refresh runs only after a reconciled batch is published; refresh failure preserves the prior dataset and must not expose pending facts.
requirements.capacity_cost: VNet data gateway consumes Premium/Fabric capacity and is a separately approved licensing/capacity cost category.
administrator_roles: Fabric or Power BI administrator able to authorize VNet gateways
Azure network contributor limited to the gateway subnet or an equivalent custom role

gate_b_evidence: Named tenant, workspace, license, capacity SKU, capacity region, and administrators
Created VNet data gateway bound to the dedicated subnet
Successful private DNS lookup of the PostgreSQL FQDN from the gateway
Successful TLS PostgreSQL connector test using a read-only reporting user
Successful Import refresh of all five reporting views
Pending transaction facts remain absent after refresh
Gateway/capacity cost is approved and monitored

no_capacity_fallback.allowed: Power BI Desktop/local demonstration only when the workstation has an approved secure route to private PostgreSQL.
prohibited: Adding a broad firewall allow rule
Uploading credentials or extracts to an unapproved service
no_capacity_fallback.blocker: Missing eligible Premium/Fabric capacity or VNet gateway licensing requires explicit user/professor direction before Gate B.
